basic_info.description: The perfect Potrero Hill pad! Located on the desirable North Slope, this bright and tranquil 1BD/1BA condo offers modern comfort, thoughtful layout, and an unbeatable location. Tucked away off calm Mariposa Street, this airy home features an open-concept living and dining area, spacious kitchen with premium Wolf range, large en-suite bath, two closets (including a walk-in), and in-unit washer/dryer. Freshly painted with double-paned windows, the interior is as functional as it is stylish. Step outside to your own oversized private patio: a sunny, secluded outdoor living room. The home also includes a deeded 1-car garage parking space with EV charger and interior access.         Located in The Potrero, this well-maintained elevator building offers a suite of amenities: fitness center, serene landscaped courtyards, rooftop deck with sweeping SF views, craft room, bike racks, laundry lockers, garbage chute on every floor, security cameras, and an on-site community manager. Whole Foods is just downstairs, and you're steps from the 17th Street bike lane, Jackson Playground, coffee shops, restaurants, the Design District, and more. With a Walk Score of 96, this is city living at its best!
